fleetApplicationStatusScreen.flaggedVehiclesCannotBeDispatchedContact: Flagged vehicles cannot be dispatched. Contact support to have one re-reviewed.

fleetWizardShell.forLogisticsCompaniesRunningMoreThan: For logistics companies running more than one vehicle. Register the company once, declare the fleet by body type and class, then put a driver behind every vehicle.

step1CompanyDetails.setWhenTheAccountWasCreated: Set when the account was created. Contact operations to change it.
step1CompanyDetails.theAddressThisAccountSignsIn: The address this account signs in with. It is also where review decisions and order correspondence go — change it if a different inbox should receive them.
step1CompanyDetails.whereTheFleetPicksUpOrders: Where the fleet picks up. Orders outside these cities are not offered to your drivers.

step3VehicleSpecifications.noVehiclesYetGoBackAnd: No vehicles yet. Go back and set how many you run in each combination.

step4DriversAssignment.everyVehicleNeedsANamedDriver: Every vehicle needs a named driver. Create the account yourself for drivers already on staff, or pick one from your roster.
step4DriversAssignment.noDriverOnYourRosterHolds: No driver on your roster holds the categories this vehicle needs. Create an account instead.
step4DriversAssignment.noVehiclesYetDeclareYourFleet: No vehicles yet — declare your fleet first.
step4DriversAssignment.shownOnceWhenYouSaveFor: Shown once when you save, for you to pass on. The driver must change it at first sign-in and upload their own licence photos before their first order.
step4DriversAssignment.thisPasswordIsShownOnceCopy: This password is shown once. Copy it before closing — we cannot show it again.

step5ReviewSubmit.theCompanyIsReviewedAsA: The company is reviewed as a whole. Individual vehicles can be sent back without holding up the rest of the fleet.
